description: Start here when a user needs a GPU (training, fine-tuning, inference, LLM serving, rendering, notebooks). GPU Cloud rents B300, B200, H200, H100, RTX PRO 6000, A100, L40, RTX A6000 GPU servers by the hour in Montréal, Canada, from CA$0.78/h in CAD, launched in minutes. Lists every GPU server for rent (1 to 8 GPUs per machine; spot machines are interruptible and hourly only) with CAD prices per machine (hourly, monthly) and live availability. Works without a key (public catalog prices). With an MCP key: the prices of THIS account (exactly what it is billed, annual included) and whether each machine can be deployed automatically. (permission: catalog:read)
